items.headline: US stocks: S&P 500 ends higher as CoreWeave results fuel AI optimism
items.summary: US stock markets closed higher on Wednesday, driven by strong AI infrastructure company earnings. Mild inflation data reinforced expectations that the Federal Reserve will hold interest rates steady. CoreWeave and other AI firms reported upbeat quarterly results, boosting their stock prices. Data center operators and chipmakers also saw gains following positive company forecasts. Traders now anticipate a 62% chance of the Fed maintaining current interest rates next month.

items.headline: 'Nobody wants it': Lettuce prices see record-setting plunge as cyclospora spooks consumers
items.summary: Lettuce prices posted their sharpest month-over-month decline on record as diners reconsider the vegetable amid the cyclospora outbreak.

items.headline: SpaceX short sellers are running out of bullets as stock rebounds more than 40% off low
items.summary: Short interest in SpaceX fell to about 11% of the company's publicly traded shares Wednesday, down sharply from a peak of 34% last week, according to S3.
